notes: Microsoft Bing SERP: 7 endpoints, one billed request per call. /search returns up to 10 organic results at data.organic_results (no pagination). /news: data.news, 10 per page, page 1-20 (about 190 articles for a broad query). /images: data.images, up to 35 per page, page 1-16 (list ends at about 550). /videos: data.videos, up to 35 per page (page 1 usually 30), page 1-4 (list ends at 140). /shopping: data.products (paid grid separately in data.sponsored_products), 36 per page (20 on Bing's list layout), page 1-9, about 180 products per query; a page past the end is a 200 with empty arrays, and with min_price/max_price a page with nothing in range is a 404. Bing Shopping serves language=en or the market's own language only (other pairs and countries without Bing Shopping are a 400). /product-details takes one product_id from /shopping (single object at data; country defaults to the product's market; a delisted product is a 404). /maps: data.places, limit 1-50 per page and page x limit must stay within 100. News, images, videos and maps pages can share a few results, so scrape.js de-duplicates. OWN ak_ keys route via slug realtime-bing-search-data (from portal_api_id).
